texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将要灭亡。
texts.en:
The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere with enough force to cause an extinction level event.

Our mission of passive observation would typically prohibit us from intervening, but many of our scientists have argued for an exception in this case. To do nothing would mean to condemn the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] to certain death.

texts.zh: 正如我们所预测，飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星撞击了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表，对其生态系统造成了难以挽回的损害。我们观测站的科学家们只能默默旁观，他们一直在研究的[GetPreFTLLower]文明的大部分都在撞击的影响下消灭殆尽。
texts.en: As predicted, the asteroid heading for [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has impacted the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, causing irreparable damage to its ecosystem. The scientists in our Observation Post could only watch in silence as the majority of the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization they had been studying was snuffed out of existence far below.

label.zh: 真是悲惨，但我们无权干涉。
label.en: A tragic fate, but it was not our place to interfere.

texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方观测站的研究人员操纵观测站的轨道推进器，令观测站与飞来的小行星进行正面碰撞。他们的牺牲使得小行星安全地偏离了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的轨道，但观测站无人生还。

显然，他们不忍看到自己花费毕生心血研究的文明就这样灭亡。
texts.en:
The researchers on our Observation Post over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] used the station's orbital thrusters to maneuver it on a direct collision course with the incoming asteroid. Their sacrifice deflected the asteroid safely away from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], but there were no survivors on the outpost.

Evidently they could not bear to watch the extinction of the civilization they had spent their careers studying.

texts.zh: 为了拯救[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]而孤注一掷，[pre_ftl_country.GetName]向小行星发射了几枚核导弹。虽然这些导弹还不足以摧毁它，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]还是成功地使小行星偏离了航行轨道。
texts.en: In a last-ditch effort to save [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched several nuclear missiles at the asteroid. Although these missiles were insufficient to destroy it, in a remarkable display of orbital mechanics, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have successfully diverted the asteroid off-course.

# 小行星正在接近[pre_ftl_planet.GetName] / Asteroid Approaching [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 观察站（前FTL观察）事件 pre-FTL observation event
- 来源 Sources：`events/observation_events.txt:19-380` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-200`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

所有观察事件共用的入口：前FTL文明的“科技进度”情境事件 preftl.50 每次检查时（该情境 1800 天内没有观察事件、也没有正在进行的观察事件链），触发 on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation 随机池（`00_on_actions.txt:140–200`，池内总权重 2860）；“破碎枷锁”起源观察自己的原文明时改用较小的池（`:205–220`，总权重 830）。进入各事件前，各事件自身的隐藏根事件还要检验条件（观察站任务、时代、AI/格式塔等）。本事件权重 50（破碎枷锁池同样 50）。根事件条件：前FTL文明首都不是人造天体、没有异常或陨石坑；全球在过去 50 年内没有目击小行星事件，或本方有观察站/游牧哨站；有观察站时任务须为被动观察；未被禁用毁灭性事件。每国一次。没有任何观察者时，根事件改发隐藏事件 observation.1（75%无事、25%撞击、5%成功拦截），不出现可见事件。 / Shared entry: each time the pre-FTL country’s tech-progress situation runs preftl.50 (no observation event in the last 1800 days and none ongoing), it fires the on_monthly_pulse_pre_ftl_observation pool (00_on_actions.txt:140–200, total weight 2860; Broken Shackles empires watching their old civilisation use a smaller pool, :205–220, total 830). Each hidden root event then checks its own conditions (outpost mission, era, AI / gestalt). Weight 50 (same in the Broken Shackles pool). Root conditions: Capital not artificial, no anomaly or impact crater; no asteroid sighting in the last 50 years globally unless we have an outpost or a nomad waystation; passive-observation mission if an outpost exists; once per country. Without any observer the root fires the hidden observation.1 instead (75% nothing / 25% impact / 5% interception).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **小行星逼近（2）**：观察站（或游牧哨站）发现一颗 4 级小行星正飞向前FTL世界；观察站被锁定。小行星抵达时隐藏随机：75% 进入隐藏事件 3；25% **5 观察站被摧毁**（科学家驾驶观察站撞向小行星，觉醒度+5、拆除观察站、违反不干涉；无观察站时为0，排外者×0.1）；5% **10 小行星被转移**（对方向小行星发射核导弹，需原子/太空时代；洞察+10、觉醒+10）。/ An asteroid heads for the planet; when it arrives a hidden roll gives 75% hidden 3, 25% the outpost sacrifices itself (5), 5% the natives deflect it with missiles (10).
2. 隐藏事件 3：若该星球仍由原始文明拥有 → **4 小行星撞击**（毁灭性撞击；解锁观察站）；否则（已成为殖民地）→ **colony.183**。/ Hidden 3: still a primitive world → 4 (impact), otherwise the colony version colony.183.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

2 之后三个结局互斥：撞击（4 或 colony.183，总概率约 71%）/ 观察站撞毁（5）/ 核导弹转移（10）。若玩家舰队在抵达前击毁小行星，则触发 observation.6（见 event-observation-6）。/ Impact (4 or colony.183), outpost sacrifice (5) and missile diversion (10) are exclusive; destroying the asteroid in time fires observation.6.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

撞击地点变体 colony.183 属于殖民地版本；观察者可以是游牧哨站。/ colony.183 is the colony-side version; the observer may be a nomad waystation.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：根 observation.0、1、2、3、4、5、10 的脚本及舰队创建逻辑。/ Roots 0–5 and 10.
- 审阅改动 Changes：编译草稿结构已核对；补充触发条件与隐藏分发事件。/ Structure confirmed; trigger conditions and hidden dispatchers documented.
